label: GO step, confident a2 choice after a rewarded trial, early in the episode (trials ~3-30)
explanation: Fires almost only at GO (99.9% of mass; never at D2, ~0 at D1). It needs the previous trial to have been rewarded (prev_reward=1 holds 99.9% of mass) and a strongly a2-favoring policy (choice logit < -4.44 holds ~100% of mass; model_act=2 every time, the next choice is a2 for 99.9% of mass). The value-head output is in a narrow high band (7.73-8.10 holds 96% of mass). It is also strongly tied to episode time: nothing before trial 3, peaks at trials 10-29, and almost nothing after trial 35. It favors episodes that started with S2 good. Predicate is GO & prev_reward=1 & choice<-4.44 & 3<=ep_trial<30 (dev F1 0.52, recall 0.95, mass recall 0.91, precision 0.36). It uses only observed variables and the agent own policy, nothing from the future. Precision is limited: the false positives look the same as hits (rewarded a2 streaks early in an episode), and only about 2664 of 6000 episodes ever activate it, so some per-episode factor I did not capture decides whether it fires. Adding start_high=0, a previous a2 choice, or two rewards in a row did not raise F1. Top activations tend to be the first GO of the window during a long rewarded a2 streak; magnitude often decays across consecutive GOs. Does not fire on a1 choices, after unrewarded trials, or late in the episode.
